prompt: How many miles are equivalent to $40,480$ yards? $(1 mile = 1,760 yards)$
explanation: Choice B is correct. It's given that $1 \text{ mile} = 1{,}760 \text{ yards}$. Therefore, $40{,}480$ yards is equivalent to $40{,}480 \text{ yards} \left(\frac{1 \text{ mile}}{1{,}760 \text{ yards}}\right)$, which can be rewritten as $\frac{40{,}480}{1{,}760}$ miles, or $23$ miles.
